name: Market Profile Value Area Reversion

crowd_strength: Buch von bekanntem Autor: J. Peter Steidlmayer / CBOT
anti_hunt: Trailing Stop → entfernt sich vom Hunt

hypothesis: Price reverts to the value area (POC/VA) when it opens inside or returns to it. ~65% of days are rotational (mean-reverting within value area). The value area represents institutional consensus of fair value.
edge_rationale: Market Profile reveals institutional price acceptance zones. POC = highest time spent = fair value. VAH/VAL = 1 std dev = 70% of time. Price tends to revert to POC because institutional rebalancing pulls it back.
best_when: Balanced/rotational markets. RTH (Regular Trading Hours). High-liquidity instruments. ~65% of trading days are rotational.
worst_when: Trend days (~15-20% of days). FOMC/major news. Low-volume periods. First 15 min (let IB form).
entry_conditions: Determine prior day POC, VAH, VAL before open
If price opens INSIDE VA: fade VAH (short) or VAL (long)
If price opens OUTSIDE VA: wait for pullback into VAH/VAL as support/resistance
Wait for IB to form (first 60 min)
Confirm with TPO structure: buying/selling tails, single prints
Enter on VA rejection with stop beyond single prints
exit_tp_logic: TP1: Opposite side of VA. TP2: Prior session POC. TP3: Measured IB extension. Trail to BE at POC.
exit_sl_logic: Beyond nearest single print zone or 1.5x IB range from entry.
reported_note: 55-65% WR on VA reversion trades. ~65% of days are rotational. No single published backtest - framework-based.
notes: Framework, not rigid system. Best on ES/NQ futures RTH. Combine with volume profile + footprint charts. Open types: Open-Drive (trend), Open-Test-Drive, Open-Auction, Open-Rejection. ~65% rotational, ~35% directional days.
